steps.text: Good morning, it's Dad here. What time is it right now?
Morning, this is Mom. What's the date today, please?
Hi, it's Hannah. What day of the week is it today?
Good morning, dear. Could you tell me what time it is?
Grandma, good morning! Did you sleep well last night?
Oh yes, I slept very well, thank you, dear.
How many minutes are left until eight o'clock?
Is today a school day or a public holiday?
Okay, I'm leaving for school now. See you later!
Could you tell me what day of the week it is?
Hannah, don't forget your lunch box today!
Got it, thank you so much for reminding me.
Dad, can you drive me to the bus stop?
Of course, let's leave in about five minutes.
Mom, have you seen my car keys anywhere?
They're on the kitchen table, next to the door.
Grandma, I'm leaving for school now!
All right, sweetheart, be careful on the road.
Tell Hannah to eat dinner tonight. There's kimchi stew in the fridge.
Tell Grandma her doctor's appointment is at three, and to take her pills after lunch.
Grandma, I'm heading out to work now, see you tonight.
Okay, be safe out there and have a good day.
What should I have for lunch today, I wonder?
Could you tell me what time it is now, please?
steps.note: clear voice - Mom's message is passed on

steps.text: Hi, I'm home now. What time is it?
